test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Her mother always __**encouraged** __the idea of early marriage.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Discouraged."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'encouraged'** means to give support, confidence or hope to someone. ((किसी को) प्रोत्‍साहित करना; (किसी की) हिम्‍मत बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example:** *The teacher **encouraged__** her students to ask questions.*
 
 
 
• The word **"discouraged"** means to dissuade or persuade someone not to do something. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति को) निरुत्‍साहित करना (यह समझाते हुए कि सफलता नहीं मिलेगी))
 __
 
• **Example:** *She **discouraged**__ me.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the mother always supported the idea of early marriage, so the antonym would be **'discouraged.'**
 
• The opposite of **'encouraged'** is **'discouraged.'**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Motivated** means to inspire or give someone a reason to do something. (विशेष प्रकार से कुछ करने का कारण बनना, प्रेरित करना)
 
• **Supported** means to give assistance or approval to someone or something. (किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना)
 
• **Cheered** means to shout in support or to express joy or approval. (किसी को स्‍पर्धा, खेल आदि में प्रोत्‍साहित करने के लिए चिल्‍लाना आदि)

15b:Td94,

The correct answer is **"Indifference."**
